Source: petersen:page-0121 ↗ def:pet-ch3-hessian-square-notation

1. ch3:3.4.2For $f:(M,g) o \mathbb R$ smooth on a connected Riemannian manifold, consider: (1) $| abla f|$ is constant; (2) $ abla _{ abla f} abla f=0$; (3) $| abla f|$ is constant on the level sets of $f$. Show $(1)\Leftrightarrow (2)\Rightarrow (3)$, and give an example showing the last implication is not an equivalence.
